name: BACH_0400
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (96%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and reliable input, but the second model disagrees and neighbors split. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 96%, Invasive 4% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 76th percentile | Typical, usable input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu | Moderate agreement |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce benign stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low score pushes concept model toward invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Low score; concept model leans away from invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score fits an in situ pattern · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction 92%** (regions 2, 10, 11) · context · 100th percentile of reference set, sampled regions only [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable, and this case leans on it.

## Could be wrong if
- The second model's different top class is correct, since neighbors also split 3 of 5.
- Region 10 alone scores 72% invasive on the older per-region probe, against 4% for the whole image.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 10** — separate in situ from invasive growth; highest per-region invasive score.
2. **Region 8** — look for stromal invasion; stroma is scarce and infiltration score is low.
3. **Regions 2, 7** — confirm atypical cells stay inside ducts and do not breach the wall.
